facts.text: Chapman University provides undergraduates with up to 4 free tuition credits during Interterm if they are enrolled full-time in both the preceding Fall and proceeding Spring semesters.

sources.title: Interterm Programs | Chapman University
sources.quote: During Interterm, Chapman University provides undergraduate students with up to 4 free tuition credits if they are enrolled at Chapman full-time in both the preceding Fall AND proceeding Spring semesters.
